input.quote: 21.3 Under no circumstances shall any Party be liable to any other Party in contract, tort, (including negligence or breach of statutory duty) or otherwise for loss (whether direct or indirect) of profits, property, traffic, business or anticipated savings, or for any indirect or consequential loss or damage in connection with the operation of this Agreement howsoever caused.
input.rationale: Paragraph 21.3 is a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential loss, which is helpful and symmetric, but no aggregate monetary cap exists anywhere in the Agreement (the only other liability provisions are the PG members' non-liability at 4.9, the mutual third-party indemnity at 21.2 limited to each Party's Schedule B share, and the claim-sharing provisions at 32.5/32.6). Each Party's direct liability therefore remains unlimited, failing even the fallback requirement of a mutual cap with carve-outs. We insert a new Subparagraph 21.4 imposing a mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and US$1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement uncapped, and confirming that amounts due are payment obligations rather than damages. The cap is drafted mutually so it does not disadvantage us relative to the other APCN 2 Parties.

ops.text: 21.4 Except in respect of Excluded Claims, the total aggregate liability of each Party to the other Parties arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim by that Party under this Agreement and (b) one million US dollars (US$1,000,000). For the purposes of this Subparagraph 21.4, "Excluded Claims" means a Party's indemnification obligations under Subparagraph 21.2, a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, a Party's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and a Party's infringement of another Party's intellectual property rights. All amounts due under this Agreement, including Customer's payment obligations, are not "damages" for the purposes of this Subparagraph 21.4.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 21 waives indirect and consequential loss but leaves each Party's direct liability uncapped, so we have added a mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and US$1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and amounts due treated as payment obligations rather than damages.
proposal.summary: Insert a mutual aggregate liability cap (greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and US$1,000,000) with the preferred carve-outs and a payment-obligations-are-not-damages statement.
